2609.13475.title: Grounded Adjudication of Variations across Extracted TimeLines (GAVEL): Comparing Clinical Timelines Against Their Case Reports
2609.13475.paper_summary: Existing pipelines for clinical timeline extraction from case reports are evaluated using an expert reference and are limited by imperfect reference annotations and imprecise event alignment. We developed GAVEL, an LLM judge protocol that compares two timelines with the case report and returns a discrepancy type, verdict, and report passage for each difference. We evaluated the event matcher, reviewed 2,738 findings from GPT5.6sol and DeepSeek V3.2, ranked six LLM extractors and two human annotators, and tested GAVEL guided merging. True match rates were 60% immediately below and 48% immediately above the 0.10 cutoff. Manual review confirmed 89.4% and 88.6% of findings. Across 126 reports, merged timelines were preferred in 77.0% of comparisons (95% CI, 69.8 to 84.1%) and reduced discrepancies attributed to the evaluated timeline from 7.63 to 0.85 per report. GAVEL supports report-based comparison and revision without treating either timeline as ground truth.
2609.13475.paper_summary_zh: 現有的臨床時間線提取管道是使用專家參考進行評估的，但受到不完美的參考註釋和不精確的事件對齊的限制。我們開發了 GAVEL，一種 LLM 判斷協議，該協議將兩個時間線與案例報告進行比較，並為每個差異返回不一致類型、裁決和報告段落。我們評估了事件匹配器，審查了來自 GPT5.6sol 和 DeepSeek V3.2 的 2,738 項發現，對六個 LLM 提取器和兩個人類註釋者進行了排名，並測試了 GAVEL 指導的合併。真實匹配率在 0.10 截止點下方為 60%，上方為 48%。手動審查確認了 89.4% 和 88.6% 的發現。在 126 份報告中，合併的時間線在 77.0% 的比較中被偏好（95% CI，69.8 到 84.1%），並將每份報告中歸因於評估時間線的差異從 7.63 減少到 0.85。GAVEL 支持基於報告的比較和修訂，而不將任何時間線視為真實基準。
